method: Built-in imagegen; references show the real app. Outputs are design proposals with example data.

proposals.name: Quiet Focus
proposals.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a named design proposal for the public FTW 0.5.0 design review. The supplied real app screenshot is a VISUAL REFERENCE, not an output to pass off as a release screenshot. Create ONE complete portrait iPhone app screen, straight-on and edge-to-edge, matching the reference's tall aspect ratio about 1206:2622. No device frame, no background outside the screen, no board title outside the UI, no collage, no cropped viewport. Premium credible native iOS typography and controls, large readable text. All copy strictly ENGLISH. Header small text 'CONCEPT · EXAMPLE DATA'. Status bar 9:41. Four native bottom tabs 'Now', 'Plan', 'History', 'Home'. Now is selected. Keep FTW's energy identity: solar yellow, home neutral, home battery cyan, grid pink, car violet. Solar only supplies the home; there is one signed grid connection; home load and car and home battery are distinct. Use this SAME example snapshot in every proposal: Solar 1.5 kW Making, Home 400 W Using, Home battery 1.1 kW Charging at 62%, Grid 0 W Balanced, Car 0 W Resting with approx. 20% assumed at plug-in. Only solar and battery ring arcs glow; zero-power grid and car arcs stay dim. Car goal: 'Model Y · 80% by 07:00', with '≈20% · assumed at plug-in'. Near-term price '0.60 SEK/kWh'. Optional plan sentence 'Battery stores spare solar until 14:45'. No fake savings, no new devices, no chatbot, no robot, no decorative green status, no settings clutter. Preserve the complete viewport and every bottom tab. This is a coherent new proposed screen, not an exact screenshot reproduction. Direction: an EVOLUTION of the current Ring / Quiet release. Refine the existing graphite ring and labels into a tighter, beautifully balanced composition. Use the ring as the main focus with a very legible 400 W Home centre. Pull the four corner labels closer to it with generous readable typography, while removing the large empty band above the ring. Add a short headline 'Solar covers the home.' Car goal becomes one clear low-contrast row. A compact broad next-12-hours plan and price area sits beneath, using softly rounded bars and restrained glow. Minimal, precise, calm, useful every day. Keep today's FTW identity strongly recognizable.

proposals.name: A Clearer Day
proposals.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new high-fidelity proposed FTW app screen for a public 0.5.0 design review. The supplied screenshot is the released app's VISUAL REFERENCE. Output ONE complete tall portrait iPhone screen with the same roughly 1206:2622 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge, straight on, NO physical phone bezel, NO collage, NO background outside the viewport, NO cropped navigation. Keep FTW's premium graphite and warm-white interface, SF-like native typography and rounded iOS controls, with restrained energy colours yellow solar, cyan home battery, pink grid, violet car. Header says 'CONCEPT · EXAMPLE DATA'. All text strictly ENGLISH. Status bar 9:41. Four native bottom tabs Now / Plan / History / Home. No chatbot, no robot, no invented savings, no unrelated devices, no generic KPI card grid. Extremely legible, few careful choices, consistent margins, calm native design. This is a distinct proposal, not an authentic release screenshot. Plan is selected. Keep the actual screen's meaning: mode Plan, planning style Careful to Bold. Example time 12:42, current price 0.51 SEK/kWh, cheapest 13:15–15:15 at 0.503 SEK/kWh. Battery stores spare solar until 15:30, reaches 82%, then supplies the home 16:15–20:45 and leaves 26%. Car target 80% by 07:00 on weekdays. Planned/forecast data must be labelled and visually distinct from recorded history. No new settings beyond these. Direction: replace the large radial time dial with a beautifully spacious horizontal day timeline. This is a proposed alternate layout. A readable headline 'Store solar for this evening.' above one broad soft chart with three clearly named lanes: Solar, Home battery, Car. Make the Next action and the car goal easy to see, while keeping the current price in a small aligned row. The timeline uses a subtle Now cursor and a few 12:00 / 18:00 / 00:00 / 06:00 ticks. Below, two concise native rows for Mode and the Careful–Bold preference. Fewer words, clearer relationship between decisions and time, not another dashboard.
